rubric.role_summary: Associate Scientist III supporting iPSC-derived cardiomyocyte models for cardiovascular disease research and drug discovery, including differentiation, genetic disease modeling, functional assays, and experimental data generation.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Associate Scientist III supporting iPSC-derived cardiomyocyte models for cardiovascular disease research and drug discovery, including differentiation, genetic disease modeling, functional assays, and experimental data generation.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- Bachelor’s or master’s degree in biology, biochemistry, or a related discipline, with at least 2 years of relevant biotech/biopharma industry experience.
- Hands-on experience with iPSC culture and iPSC-derived cardiomyocyte models.
- Hands-on molecular assay expertise; the listed assays are examples, not a requirement to have used every assay.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience with 3D or engineered heart tissue platforms or organoids.
- Background in cardiomyocyte biology and/or cardiovascular disease.
- Exposure to and experience with high-throughput platforms and/or automated systems.
- Deep hands-on experience in iPSC culture, cardiac directed differentiation, and characterization of iPSC-CM models in 2D monolayer format.
- Experience developing genetic iPSC-CM disease models to study cardiovascular mechanisms; patient-derived lines and CRISPR-edited isogenic pairs are cited examples.
- Experience with functional assays relevant to cardiomyocyte biology; the listed assay types are examples, not a requirement to have used every type.
- Track record of executing rigorous experiments and communicating findings through publications, presentations, or internal reports.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): San Francisco Bay Area, California. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Onsite work is based in one of these areas. Explicit work-attendance terms (city labels use the area interpretation above): Based in South San Francisco, this position reports directly to Senior Scientist, Cardiometabolic Disease - Translational Genetics and requires you to be onsite at our South San Francisco office 5 days per week.
